tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This policy will be filled in once a decision is made and recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

Muninn has no decision or rule on compression. Its only compression material is two bare one-word episodes, "gzip" and "zstd", from separate sessions. Both are trust 1 and neither says what was decided, so I didn't treat either as a decision.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the file tool instead.
